_note: Applied by the /advance route when a hero crosses an XP threshold. hpGain = fixed (average roll + Con mod, the SRD default). newSlots replaces the slots map wholesale. newActions append; newFeatures append.

newFeatures: Action Surge: once per rest, take one additional action on your turn — tell the DM when you use it.
Channel Divinity (1/rest): Preserve Life — restore HP equal to 5× your level, split among allies below half HP.
Arcane Recovery: once per day after a short rest, recover a 1st-level spell slot.
Cunning Action: Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action — narrate it and the DM honors it.
Reckless Attack: gain advantage on melee attacks this turn; attacks against you also have advantage.

newActions.name: Hunter's Mark
newActions.text: Mark a quarry: an extra 1d6 lands with your focus. (Simplified: one bonus strike.)

newActions.name: Divine Smite
newActions.text: Channel your oath through the blade — radiant fury on a hit.

newFeatures: Jack of All Trades: add half proficiency to every ability check.
